viewing_check: Turn the jar over and photograph the base for an impressed Doulton Lambeth, Denby or Bourne mark and any chips or cracks (a Doulton marble jar adds value). Check lid fit and rim for chips, glass for cracks, and whether the cabinet interior has the original pipe racks.
